title: WorkItem
description: A single unit of work in a queue, representing one data record to be processed by a bot

id.description: Unique identifier of the work item

queueId.description: ID of the queue this work item belongs to

json.description: Key-value map of the work item's data payload matching the queue's work item model attributes

status.description: Current processing status of the work item

result.description: Processing result set by the bot upon completion

col1.description: Display column 1 value extracted from the work item data

col2.description: Display column 2 value extracted from the work item data

col3.description: Display column 3 value extracted from the work item data

deviceId.description: ID of the device that processed this work item

deviceUserId.description: ID of the user account under which the work item was processed

automationId.description: Deployment ID of the automation that processed this work item

error.description: Error message if the work item processing failed

retryCount.description: Number of times this work item has been retried

deferredUntil.description: ISO 8601 timestamp until which this work item is deferred

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created this work item

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the work item was created
